name: Coprime Shift Disguise
description: Replaced the reciprocal fraction equality check with a condition that (x+4) and (y+4) share a common factor > 1. Since the shifted domain is {5, 6, 7}, which are pairwise coprime, they only share a factor if x=y. This prevents models from pattern-matching the fractional math to equality, forcing them to evaluate the pairwise condition to discover the 3-coloring structure.
